verdict.rationale: Ashby documents webhooks that fire on events like candidate status changes, job posting updates and interview scheduling, enabling automated responses, with signed payloads. Its Slack integration can also automatically create interview channels. However, acting on webhooks requires building your own external handler, and no native in-app rule builder (if-event-then-action) is evidenced; custom agents in Ashby Assistant handle repeated workflows but are not shown to be event-triggered. Missing for 10: native configurable trigger/condition/action rules inside Ashby, AI-driven event-triggered automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
